about: Frame lines: a matching set of head / core / arms / booster / legs from one maker with its own silhouette and role. Every frame part in parts.json carries line = one of these ids. suggestedBonus = a set-bonus idea for wearing 3+ parts of the line (null for legs-only lines, which cannot make a set). isNew = added in Overdrive Frame round 7.

lines.name: Wisp
lines.look: A narrow arrowhead frame with a whip antenna and a glowing waist ring.
lines.role: Light skirmisher: fast, fragile, cheap boosts.
lines.suggestedBonus: Quick boosts cost 20% less energy for 2 s after a quick boost.

lines.name: Stride
lines.look: The Celerity all-rounder: swept crest blades, a wedge chest and skirted legs.
lines.role: Balanced energy-weapon frame for any mission.
lines.suggestedBonus: Energy weapons build 15% less heat while you are moving.

lines.name: Halberd
lines.look: Celerity at its heaviest: cheek plates, flank armour and a four-nozzle booster.
lines.role: Front-line energy frame that still boosts well.
lines.suggestedBonus: Energy hits taken are reduced a further 10% while boosting.

lines.name: Heron
lines.look: Sleek bird legs with knife-edge toes.
lines.role: Jumping legs for a light frame.

lines.name: Glider
lines.look: A delta hover skirt with swept fins.
lines.role: Fast hover legs for light loads.

lines.name: Vantage
lines.look: A tall recon frame: a sensor-mast head, a dorsal blade, long scoped arms, a tail fin and stilt bird legs with sensor vanes.
lines.role: Long-range spotter and sniper platform: sees and locks first, jumps high, hits from far away.
lines.suggestedBonus: Enemies you lock stay marked for allies for 5 s and take 10% more damage from everyone.

lines.name: Rapier
lines.look: A bladed duellist: a crested helm with one eye slit, a wasp-waisted V chest with coat-tail fins, tonfa-bladed arms and spiked legs.
lines.role: Close-in duellist: lunges with the strongest quick boost and finishes with blades.
lines.suggestedBonus: A quick boost toward an enemy makes your next melee hit within 1 s deal 40% more damage.

lines.name: Mule
lines.look: A squat Brannoch work frame with a single work lamp.
lines.role: Cheap, tough starter frame.
lines.suggestedBonus: Kinetic weapons reload 15% faster.

lines.name: Bastion
lines.look: The Brannoch standard: a slab cab, side armour, hazard stripes and exhaust stacks.
lines.role: Armoured all-rounder for kinetic and explosive weapons.
lines.suggestedBonus: Taking a hit over 10% of your armour points gives 15% damage resistance for 3 s.

lines.name: Mountain
lines.look: The heaviest Brannoch biped: a turret-bucket head with an antenna mast and four exhausts.
lines.role: Slow walking fortress that carries the biggest guns.
lines.suggestedBonus: Standing still for 1 s cuts recoil and spread by 30%.

lines.name: Ox
lines.look: Chunky four legs with hazard-striped body plates.
lines.role: Steady gun platform legs.

lines.name: Crawler
lines.look: Heavy Brannoch tank treads.
lines.role: Carry anything, never jump.

lines.name: Redoubt
lines.look: A siege frame: a periscope bunker head, a sloped casemate core with sandbag ridges, gun-carriage arms with mantlet shields and four braced legs on pads.
lines.role: Siege anchor: the most armour and steadiest aim; holds a position and shells it.
lines.suggestedBonus: Standing still for 1.5 s braces the legs: +25% damage resistance and shoulder weapons fire 20% faster until you move.

lines.name: Breaker
lines.look: A breacher on treads: a caged welding-mask head, a wedge-prowed core, ram shoulders over huge fists and a dozer blade.
lines.role: Wall-breaker: rams through cover and crowds at melee and shotgun range.
lines.suggestedBonus: Boosting into an enemy or a structure rams it for heavy kinetic damage and knocks it back; rams cost you no armour.

lines.name: Lily
lines.look: A Calyx light frame with one big eye and glowing pod lamps.
lines.role: Light endurance frame that feeds its boosters well.
lines.suggestedBonus: Generator recharge starts 0.3 s sooner.

lines.name: Shell
lines.look: The Calyx standard: a three-eyed bulb head and a beetle-shell core.
lines.role: Balanced endurance frame for odd weapons.
lines.suggestedBonus: Electric and repair weapons draw 15% less energy.

lines.name: Carapace
lines.look: The heaviest Calyx frame: mandible plates and side carapace.
lines.role: Tough endurance frame that runs cool.
lines.suggestedBonus: Overheating vents 30% faster.

lines.name: Drift
lines.look: A Calyx jellyfish hover bell with hanging fins.
lines.role: Floaty hover legs.

lines.name: Mantis
lines.look: Calyx four legs with long tapering spike shins.
lines.role: Steady four legs for a medium frame.

lines.name: Bloom
lines.look: A hover medic frame: a flower head round a lamp eye, a core hung with pod clusters, a halo shield emitter and a ring of floating seed pods.
lines.role: Support and shield frame: the most power to weapons, cool running and the longest hover.
lines.suggestedBonus: Your repairs heal 15% more, and allies within 3 tiles regain 1% armour per second.

lines.name: Sickle
lines.look: A mantis hunter: a triangle head with compound eyes and feelers, a hunched thorax with a hanging abdomen, scythe forearms and clawed bird legs.
lines.role: Hunter-killer: fast, quick to turn, pounces and cuts down single targets.
lines.suggestedBonus: Melee kills refund a quick boost and give 20% speed for 3 s.

lines.name: Tinker
lines.look: An oil-drum head on a roll-caged forklift cab.
lines.role: The cheapest frame in the city.
lines.suggestedBonus: Picking up scrap restores 2% armour.

lines.name: Junker
lines.look: A camera-box head and a tyre for armour.
lines.role: Cheap all-rounder that runs hot.
lines.suggestedBonus: Fire weapons burn 20% longer.

lines.name: Hulk
lines.look: A caged floodlight head and a rocket-drum booster.
lines.role: The heaviest scrap frame.
lines.suggestedBonus: When armour drops below 30%, heat build-up halves for 5 s (once per minute).

lines.name: Hopper
lines.look: Scrap bird legs with a coil spring on each foot bone.
lines.role: Jumping legs on the cheap.

lines.name: Rustcrawler
lines.look: Patchwork treads with a fuel drum strapped on.
lines.role: Cheap heavy-carry treads.

lines.name: Hauler
lines.look: A junk-crawler: a crane-cab head with a beacon, a skip-bin core heaped with scrap, a crane jib and winch, an exhaust stack and treads with forklift tines.
lines.role: Heavy hauler: carries the biggest weapon load for its price and runs turrets and mines.
lines.suggestedBonus: Deployed turrets, mines and drones get +30% armour and last 25% longer; +1 deploy charge.

lines.name: Pogo
lines.look: A scrappy hopper: an upturned bucket head with a traffic-light eye, a barrel body with a flag, scaffold-pole arms and big pogo-spring bird legs.
lines.role: Cheap hopper: the biggest jump for the price and twitchy quick boosts.
lines.suggestedBonus: Landing from a jump shocks enemies nearby for light electric damage and staggers small ones.
